title: Global Ingress SSL Handshake Failures
description: All mobile clients and browsers reporting SSL certificate expired on api.orange.com. All backend containers are completely healthy.

ground_truth.root_cause_summary: TLS certificate expired on ingress gateway because automated cert-manager renewal cron job failed 48 hours ago due to DNS-01 challenge credentials failure.
key_evidence: Gateway logs show SSL_ERROR_CERT_EXPIRED with validity ending 2026-10-24T21:59:00Z
Topology shows api-gateway ingress TLS cert expiration timestamp in the past
Zero recent code deployments to backend services
distractors: Backend services show 100% health checks passing (because internal traffic bypasses public TLS)

logs.message: SSL Handshake Failed: Certificate expired at 2026-10-24T21:59:59Z
Automated renewal failed: Cloudflare API token invalid for DNS-01 challenge
